basis: Standard API-equivalent estimates, not subscription charges, provider-reported spending or invoices. No Batch, fast mode, regional or negotiated adjustments. This additive evidence records the review of 2026-11-15, which looked for models priced through a rule that did not name them. It found three: every Grok 4.x model took the rates of a model xAI no longer lists, kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed took Kimi K3's rates, and before the 2026-11-13 review Claude Fable 5.2 took Claude Fable 5's. models lists each row added or corrected, with the line that prices it. anthropicModelTable is every row of Anthropic's model table as printed that day; the Claude rules now name those versions and no others, so a later version counts as missing until a review prices it. namedIds lists every other ID a rule names without a row here, so the version check knows them. notPricedOnPurpose lists models the pages name that stay unpriced, each with its reason. retrievedAt is the review's date in the Americas; fetchedAt is the UTC instant the pages were read. pageNormalizedSha256 is the SHA-256 of each page's text as scripts/provider-contract-lib.mjs normalizes it. Kimi's page is rendered by script, so its quotes are the table cells as its source carries them. xAI bills a request at the long-context rates once its prompt reaches 200k tokens, read here as 200,000, so the tier starts above 199,999. Earlier evidence files are retained unchanged. These rows were read on 2026-11-15 and read again from the providers' pages on 2026-11-18 (reverified). effectiveFrom is the release date or month the provider's own release notes give; xAI's notes give months only. A row with no published date says so in effectiveFromNote.
